item.title: procrastination is burning my future
item.description: For a long time, I had been preparing myself to learn French. I collected countless resources, put together a detailed study plan, and even created an Excel spreadsheet to organize my YouTube learning sessions. But in the end, nothing happened. I had wasted so much time scrolling here and there, searching for the most promising YouTube channel—the magical one that would somehow make me speak French better than a native speaker in just three months.

item.title: What happened to the people??
item.description: When I try to understand what’s happening to people, I’m amazed at why they do this to themselves. I don’t pretend I’m special, and yes, I make mistakes sometimes, and I have to admit I grew up around people who lived simply and within their means which made me think wisly in a lot of things around me. But what I see now is that people are living inside their minds, what is that mean?
